### What You Find In Your Quiet Times
Author: Kevin DeYoung
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/kevin-deyoung/what-you-find-in-your-quiet-times/
Passage: 1 Chronicles 1:1-4, 24-27
Points:
- Lengthy genealogical lists can feel monotonous, but prayerful reading reveals foundational spiritual truth.
- The opening chapters of 1 Chronicles anchor God's covenant people in actual space-and-time history.
- The Chronicler presents Adam as a real historical individual alongside known ancestors like Abraham.
- Scripture does not interweave mythical characters with genuine human history.
- Remembering our true historical lineage provides reassuring certainty for believers walking with God.

### Bible Pathway - May 11, 2010
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-may-11-2010-11631409.html
Passage: 1 Chronicles 1:1
Points:
- The ancient genealogical record starting with Adam highlights God's sovereign guidance across generations toward the Messiah.
- Adam points forward to Jesus Christ, the last Adam, who imparts life-giving spiritual renewal.
- God's active involvement in these historical lineages demonstrates His care for the details of our lives.
- Hardships and everyday events are not random accidents, but are purposeful designs directed by God.
- Believers are challenged to trust God completely rather than relying merely on human understanding.
